attBesluta.text: Extremely well held heavy duty, great hydraulic system. great for a garage type workshop. I plan on putting a 3/4 inch plywood top to make it a little larger to lift up generators to work on

These screens are excellent! Very easy to assemble and very mobile! I particularly liked how they join to the centre screen, makes it very easy to fold them together and move out when you need them out of the way.
Will do the job. Good welds. Supplied with all pins needed.
The hitch works great for the back of my small tractor!
Bought this for my Kubota, great for attaching trailer hitch and land scape rake, with out having to disconnect the three point hitch. I will definately but more attachments to use it with
The quality and price are top notch. I highly recommend.
Very nice good quality. Like it came with all the pins and clips needed.
